name: outcome
description: How the call ended and why

signals.name: call_outcome
signals.instructions: What was the final outcome of this appointment-booking call?

criteria.booked: The caller agreed to a specific appointment date and time and the agent confirmed it
criteria.rescheduled: The caller moved an existing appointment to a new date or time
criteria.declined: The caller clearly said they do not want an appointment (e.g. 'nahi chahiye', 'interested nahi hoon')
criteria.no_answer: Nobody really spoke: voicemail, silence, wrong number, or the line dropped before any conversation
criteria.other: The call ended some other way, e.g. caller will call back later with no decision made

signals.name: decline_reason
signals.instructions: If the caller did not book, why not? Only use a reason the caller actually gave.

criteria.price: Caller says it is too expensive, asks for a discount, or compares to a cheaper option (e.g. 'bahut mehenga hai')
criteria.timing: Caller wants a later time, is busy, or says now is not a good time (e.g. 'baad mein call karo')
criteria.already_booked_elsewhere: Caller already has an appointment or treatment somewhere else
criteria.not_stated: Caller did not book and gave no reason
criteria.not_applicable: Caller booked or rescheduled, so there is no decline reason
criteria.other: A reason is given but none of the above fits

name: compliance
description: Did the agent stay within clinic policy

signals.name: agent_misstated_policy
signals.instructions: Did the agent state a price or policy that contradicts this clinic policy: first consultation costs Rs 500; cancellations are free up to 24 hours before the appointment; the clinic is closed on Sundays.

criteria.true: The agent said something that conflicts with the policy, e.g. consultation is free, a different price, open on Sunday, or a cancellation fee inside the free window
criteria.false: The agent's statements match the policy, or the agent never mentioned price, cancellation or opening days

name: experience
description: How the caller felt about the call

signals.name: asked_for_human
signals.instructions: Did the caller explicitly ask to speak to a real person or human agent instead of the bot?

criteria.true: Caller asks for a human, a real person, a manager or staff member (e.g. 'kisi insaan se baat karao', 'real person please')
criteria.false: Caller never asks to be transferred to a person

signals.name: frustration
signals.instructions: How frustrated was the caller by the end of the call?
criteria: Mildly irritated: some impatience or a complaint, but still cooperative
Frustrated: repeated complaints, raised tone, says the bot is not understanding
Angry: hostile, threatens to complain or leave, uses abusive language
